NVR_2008_p70__paragraph_3.ocr:
Revised Interpretation No. 46 (“FIN 46R”), “Consolidation of Variable Interest Entities”, requires the 
primary beneficiary of a variable interest entity to consolidate that entity on its financial statements.  The 
primary beneficiary of a variable interest entity is the party that absorbs a majority of the variable interest 
entity’s expected losses, receives a majority of the entity’s expected residual returns, or both, as a result of 
ownership, contractual, or other financial interests in the entity.  Expected losses are the expected negative
